measurement_origin: Python postprocessing of the archived simulator PSF-ASCII values. CSVs and figures are derived results, not simulator-native signed reports.

numerical_conventions.PSF: Read quoted signal/value rows after VALUE; retain full precision and actual simulator sample times.
numerical_conventions.sampling: Linear interpolation at explicitly listed probe times; settled voltages use an arithmetic average of saved voltage samples inside the specified half-open window.
numerical_conventions.crossing: First directional crossing within the specified window, linearly interpolated between neighboring saved samples.
numerical_conventions.integral: Trapezoidal integration over the full transient [first saved time,last saved time].
numerical_conventions.comparison_baseline: unit_collapse for all 84 scalar metrics and 56 RC/RCC comparison rows. The PT prior sizing-control curve is a separate additional control.
numerical_conventions.signed_change_percent: 100*(post-unit_collapse)/abs(unit_collapse); blank if baseline is zero or a value is unavailable.
numerical_conventions.percentage_caution: Near-zero or signed baseline quantities can yield large or misleading percentages. Signed lag and energy-return power are not automatically improvement/degradation measures. Absolute values are retained.
numerical_conventions.completion: Full specified duration, finite saved traces, receipt returncode 0 and native log completion. This does not imply all specifications pass.

CLK-CMP.decision_mean_ps: Mean of six stable complementary 80/20-level response times measured from the clock 50% time (probe_ns-3.95)*1e-9. For each interval [edge,(probe_ns+0.5)ns), find the last violating saved point and use the next sample. This is not a 50%-output propagation delay.
CLK-CMP.fixed_gate: For each probe, out>=0.64/outb<=0.16 when expected high; converse when expected low.

CT-CMP.rise_signed_lag_ps: 1e12*(output rising 0.4V crossing - input differential rising zero crossing), both sought in [4,10] ns
CT-CMP.fall_signed_lag_ps: 1e12*(output falling 0.4V crossing - input differential falling zero crossing), both sought in [14,20] ns
CT-CMP.signed_lag_interpretation: An output crossing can precede the differential zero crossing because of offset and finite slew. A negative lag is not negative causal propagation delay.
CT-CMP.DC_trip_mV: 1000*differential DC input at first rising out=0.4 V crossing in [-0.05,0.05] V

DC-Switch.fixed_gate: Each of 20 sampled absolute rail errors is <0.1V. No efficiency gate.

PT-CMP.word_expected: 1 if each adjacent pair of the eight input bits agrees; otherwise 0
PT-CMP.rise_mean_signed_lag_ps: Mean of the three rising output-0.4V crossings minus their corresponding input 50% times (i*10ns+50ps). Crossing search [i*10ns,(i*10+9)ns].
PT-CMP.fall_mean_signed_lag_ps: Same, mean of the four falling transitions.
PT-CMP.transition_onset_to_crossing_ps: signed_crossing_lag_ps+50; retained as a second timing convention, not substituted silently for the signed lag
PT-CMP.persistent_valid_rail_from_onset_ps: Within each transition interval, time from i*10ns to the first saved point after the last violation of expected out>=0.64 or <=0.16.
PT-CMP.fixed_gate: All eight fixed-word samples satisfy >=0.64V for expected1, <=0.16V for expected0.
PT-CMP.10_percent: Not the reported fixed functional gate. The archived post-layout delay changes are much larger than 10%; a uniform electrical-equivalence claim is not supported.

REF-BUF.settling_rise_ns: Time from 200ns to the first sample after the last departure from +/-1% of the measured output-step amplitude around mean_high, evaluated up to 399ns.
REF-BUF.settling_fall_ns: Same, relative to 400ns and mean_low, evaluated up to 599ns.
REF-BUF.settling_caution: 1% of the measured output step is not 1% input tracking accuracy. If no settling in the window, value is unavailable.
REF-BUF.PSF_duplicate_vin_handling: The DC parameter and saved node both use vin, creating two equal adjacent values per point. Verify pair equality to 1e-14V and use one per pair; do not average unrelated points.
REF-BUF.recorded_probe: mean_high>mean_low only. This is not a precision/full application specification.
REF-BUF.STB: Use the native margin.stb header gainMargin[dB], phaseMargin[degrees] and the respective frequencies[Hz]. Header precision is higher than rounded VALUE fields. Local VFB1 loop, VFB2 closed; no RCC/global multi-loop result.

not_verified_by_this_script: Completeness of original historical optimization population
Electrical specifications not stated in the archived probe definitions
